t:
(a) 
Strategic Plan for Science and Engineering Education.—Section 107 of the Education for Economic Security Act (20 U.S.C. 3917) is repealed.
 
    (b) 
Budget Estimate.—Section 14 of the National Science Foundation Act of 1950 (42 U.S.C. 1873) is amended by striking subsection (j).

fable.w: The section only repeals a strategic-plan provision and strikes a budget-estimate subsection. The tempting reading is that a "Strategic Plan" heading implies consultation with outside parties, but the text creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision.
fable.s: Section 107 of the Education for Economic Security Act (20 U.S.C. 3917) is repealed.

qwen_block.w: This section only repeals existing statutory provisions and does not establish any new mechanism for public participation, consultation, or coordination with outside entities. It removes text from the code rather than creating a process for outside involvement in federal decision-making.
qwen_block.s: Section 107 of the Education for Economic Security Act (20 U.S.C. 3917) is repealed. ... Section 14 of the National Science Foundation Act of 1950 (42 U.S.C. 1873) is amended by striking subsection (j).
qwen_block.b:
1.  **Think briefly**: The section consists entirely of repealing existing statutory provisions (Section 107 of the Education for Economic Security Act and subsection (j) of Section 14 of the National Science Foundation Act of 1950). It does not create any new processes, advisory bodies, comment periods, or consultation requirements. It simply removes text from the code. There is no mention of outside parties participating in a decision. The tempting reading might be that "Budget Estimate" implies some process, but the text only says the section is struck (repealed), not that a new participatory process is created. Therefore, the label is "No".

opus.s: Section 107 of the Education for Economic Security Act (20 U.S.C. 3917) is repealed.
